      "end": 122.0,
      "speaker": "Seth Woolcock",
      "text": "All right and welcome into the BettingPros podcast... time to place your bets for the NFL future award markets."
    },
    {
      "start": 122.0,
      "end": 174.0,
      "speaker": "Seth Woolcock",
      "text": "And Andrew, let's start in the MVP market where last year Matthew Stafford won the NFL MVP."
    },
    {
      "start": 174.0,
      "end": 312.0,
      "speaker": "Andrew Erickson",
      "text": "So the ones that I like the most from the favorites are Joe Burrow and Justin Herbert. Those are kind of the two guys that stand out to me as some decent values."
    },
    {
      "start": 312.0,
      "end": 350.0,
      "speaker": "Seth Woolcock",
      "text": "Hey, that's totally understandable... any thoughts about maybe slow playing that or do you think this is the year they start fast?"
    },
    {
      "start": 350.0,
      "end": 418.0,
      "speaker": "Andrew Erickson",
      "text": "Well, if you recall to last year, they didn't have a slow start. They were 2 and 0... So I'm not as hesitant to fire on this now."
    },
    {
      "start": 418.0,
      "end": 513.0,
      "speaker": "Andrew Erickson",
      "text": "Justin Herbert, who I think is probably my favorite of the two of the more favored guys. He did get an MVP vote last year."
    },
    {
      "start": 513.0,
      "end": 518.0,
      "speaker": "Seth Woolcock",
      "text": "It's an interesting number... what's your best overall value, maybe a little bit of a long shot in this particular market, Andrew?"
    },
    {
      "start": 518.0,
      "end": 605.0,
      "speaker": "Andrew Erickson",
      "text": "For me it's Trevor Lawrence at 24 to 1 to win the MVP award. I don't always want to cite fantasy stats, but after week 5, no quarterback scored more fantasy points than Trevor Lawrence did."
    },
    {
      "start": 605.0,
